s.note: Blinis with crème fraîche and salmon, garlic toast with tomato and basil
s.how: Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche and 100g smoked salmon. Toast 12 baguette slices, rub with garlic and top with 2 diced tomatoes and basil. Arrange both on silver trays.

s.note: Six minute eggs with buttered toast strips for dipping
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes. Toast 4 thick slices white bread golden, butter and cut into soldiers. Put each egg in a cup, take the top off and dip away.

m.note: Beef chuck, carrots and potatoes braised for 3 hours, with crusty bread
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add 600g potatoes, 750ml stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until the meat falls apart. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Steamed fruit pudding soaked in brandy, flamed at the table, with custard
w.how: Soak 500g dried fruit in 100ml brandy overnight. Mix with 125g butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 100g breadcrumbs, 75g flour and 2 tsp mixed spice. Steam 4 hours. Warm 2 tbsp brandy, light it and pour over at the table. Serve with custard.

d.note: Cooked custard eggnog with brandy and fresh nutmeg, served chilled
d.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream, then stir over low heat to 75C. Chill well, stir in 100ml brandy and grate fresh nutmeg on top.
